links.outcome: Global quality score of LLM extraction across three hospital centers
links.effect: DeepSeek-R1 (P=.277) and GPT-o3 (P=.072) stable across centers; DeepSeek-V3 and Gemini 2.5 Pro differed significantly across centers (P<.001), e.g., V3 4.53 at ZS vs 4.93 at FJ.
links.quote: In contrast, DeepSeek-V3 and Gemini 2.5 Pro showed unstable performance when confronted with heterogeneous content from different centers, with statistically significant differences in global quality scores across the three centers ( P <.001 for both).

links.outcome: Trainee extraction accuracy and time with vs without LLM assistance
links.effect: Quality scores improved with LLM assistance (F=14.658; P<.001); per-tier error rates fell 3.2% to 1.0% and 2.4% to 0.5%; time reduced 74.5%-82.6%.
links.quote: Calculated per individual tier, the error rate for Trainee 1 decreased from 3.2% (13/410) to 1.0% (4/410), while the error rate for Trainee 2 decreased from 2.4% (10/410) to 0.5% (2/410), Fig. 5 c.

links.outcome: Error rate and severity of LLM structured extraction versus expert ground truth
links.effect: Error rates: DeepSeek-R1 3.9% (n=15), GPT-o3 9.3%, DeepSeek-V3 12.0%, Gemini 2.5 Pro 14.8%; major errors comprised 35.1%-60.0% of each model's errors.
links.quote: DeepSeek-R1 exhibited the highest accuracy, with a total error rate of only 3.9% ( n = 15).
